Tilberedning og præsentation af autentiske indiske retter

Tilberedning af curryretter, tandoorretter, naan og andre traditionelle indiske specialiteter

Vi forventer, at du

• 
Har dokumenteret professionel erfaring som kok

Har solid erfaring med autentisk indisk madlavning

• 
Har erfaring med tandoorovn og traditionelle indiske curryretter

• 
Har godt kendskab til indiske krydderier, marinader og traditionelle tilberedningsmetoder

Kan arbejde selvstændigt og effektivt i et travlt restaurantkøkken

Er kvalitetsbevidst, stabil, ansvarsfuld og samarbejdsvillig

Fast fuldtidsansættelse, 37 timer om ugen

En arbejdsplads i en etableret og populær restaurant i centrum af Aalborg

• 
Et professionelt og internationalt arbejdsmiljø

Et erfarent team med fokus på kvalitet og autentisk indisk mad

Gode muligheder for faglig udvikling og ansvar

Ordentlige ansættelses- og arbejdsforhold

Jalsa Indisk Restaurant Aalborg
Ved Stranden 5, st. tv.
9000 Aalborg

Send dit CV og en kort ansøgning samt relevante oplysninger om din erhvervserfaring til info@jalsa.dk.

Jalsa Indian Restaurant Aalborg is looking for an experienced chef specializing in authentic Indian cuisine

Jalsa Indian Restaurant Aalborg is looking for a skilled and experienced chef to join our established kitchen team.

Jalsa is a well-established Indian restaurant with locations in both Aalborg and Randers. Our Aalborg restaurant has built a strong position and a good reputation among our guests, and we continue to experience high demand. We are therefore looking to strengthen our kitchen team with another experienced chef who has solid professional experience in authentic Indian cuisine.

As a chef, you will be an important part of the daily kitchen operation. Your responsibilities will include:

•

We expect that you

•

• 
Have solid experience with authentic Indian cuisine

• 
Have experience working with a tandoor oven and traditional Indian curry dishes

• 
Have good knowledge of Indian spices, marinades and traditional cooking techniques

• 
Are able to work independently and efficiently in a busy restaurant kitchen

• 
Are quality-conscious, reliable, responsible and cooperative

• 
Are able to stay organized and focused during busy periods

• 
Are flexible regarding working hours and able to work weekdays, evenings and weekends

• 
Are able to communicate in English. Knowledge of Danish is an advantage but not a requirement

We offer

• 
Permanent full-time employment, 37 hours per week

• 
A position in an established and popular restaurant in central Aalborg

• 
A professional and international working environment

• 
An experienced team with a strong focus on quality and authentic Indian cuisine

• 
Good opportunities for professional development and responsibility

• 
Salary based on qualifications and in accordance with applicable Danish rules

• 
Proper employment and working conditions

Workplace

Jalsa Indian Restaurant Aalborg
Ved Stranden 5, ground floor, left
9000 Aalborg
Denmark

jobs.occupation: Erfaren tømrer søges til Malerfirmaet DMR / Experienced carpenter for Malerfirmaet DMR
jobs.description:
SEE ENGLISH VERSION BELOW

Malerfirmaet DMR er en veletableret virksomhed beliggende på Søborg Hovedgade i Dyssegård, som gennem årene har leveret professionelle malerydelser til en bred vifte af kundetyper. Udover malerydelser tilbyder vi også tømrer- og gulvarbejde.

Vi søger netop nu 1-2 erfaren kollegaer til vores tømrerteam, som kan være med til at løse virksomhedens opgaveportefølje.

Har du erfaring som tømrer og er du passioneret omkring dit arbejde, så kan vi tilbyde dig en attraktiv arbejdsplads med højt humør!

Om jobbet:

Hos Malerfirmaet DMR kommer du til at arbejde med række forskellige tømreropgave, bl.a. opbygning af gulvkonstruktioner, montering af gipsplader, opbygning af lettere trækonstruktioner m.m.

Du vil blive tilknyttet en kollega, så I altid er to om opgaverne, ved små opgaver må man forvente at arbejde selvstændigt. Som makkerpar får I stillet en firmabil til rådighed med de nødvendige maskiner og værktøj.

Vi forventer, at du:

1. Har minimum 1 års erfaring indenfor tømrerfaget

2. Har kørekort B

3. Er pligtopfyldende og letforståelig på engelsk eller dansk

4. Afslutter en opgave ryddelig og kvalitetsbevidst

Vi tilbyder:

1. Attraktiv løn

2. Arbejdstid i tidsrummet 07:00-15:00

3. Kollegaer du kan sparrer med

4. Spændende og alsidige opgave

Lyder stillingen interessant, eller har du spørgsmål? Så er du meget velkommen til at kontakte os på mail info@dmrmalerarbejde.dk

Vi ser frem til din ansøgning og cv.

Samtaler afholdes løbende med ansættelse hurtigst muligt.

ENGLISH:

Malerfirmaet DMR is a well-established company located on Søborg Hovedgade in Dyssegård. Over the years, we have provided professional painting services to a wide range of customers. In addition to painting, we also offer carpentry and flooring services.

We are currently looking for 1–2 experienced colleagues to join our carpentry team and help us handle our growing portfolio of projects.

If you have experience as a carpenter and are passionate about your work, we can offer you an attractive workplace with a positive and friendly atmosphere.

About the job

At Malerfirmaet DMR, you will work on a variety of carpentry tasks, including building floor structures, installing plasterboard/drywall, constructing light timber structures, and other related carpentry work.

You will normally work together with a colleague, so there will usually be two of you assigned to each project. For smaller jobs, however, you should be comfortable working independently.

As a team, you will have access to a company vehicle equipped with the necessary machinery and tools.

We expect you to:

1. Have at least 1 year of experience working as a carpenter

2. Hold a valid Category B driving licence

3. Be reliable, responsible and able to communicate in English or Danish

4. Take pride in completing your work to a high standard and leaving the work area clean and tidy

We offer:

1. Attractive salary

2. Working hours between 07:00 and 15:00

3. Supportive and experienced colleagues you can exchange knowledge with

4. Exciting and varied carpentry projects

Does the position sound interesting, or do you have any questions? You are very welcome to contact us by email at info@dmrmalerarbejde.dk.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV.

Interviews will be held on an ongoing basis, and we are looking for someone who can start as soon as possible.

Do you want to contribute to protecting energy systems of the future and secure OT infrastructure in Renewable Energy? Then apply to become part of an international and market-leading asset management consultancy within the renewable energy industry. PEAK Wind is looking for a Cyber Security Consultant, who wants to take their cyber security career to the next level and is looking to work on a diverse and exciting portfolio within wind power and other renewable Energy sources.

Trusted Advisors for Developers and Investors for some of the Largest Renewable Assets
At PEAK Wind, we specialise in operations, asset management, and project management of Renewable Energy assets and take pride in providing best-in-class commercial, financial, and operational advisory and support to our clients. We work with some of the world’s largest infrastructure investments and are proud to count market-leading utilities, investment funds, and independent power producers among our clients.

Job Content, Responsibilities, and Possibilities:
Based in one of our offices in Denmark (Aarhus and Copenhagen), or Germany (Hamburg) you will be working in a team supporting customer projects and programs within the field of IT/OT and cyber security. We are a dedicated team of mixed seniorities and nationalities with a collaborative working environment. SCADA and Cyber Security is a crucial area for our clients, who we support on both greenfield and brownfield projects. The team works across disciplines, ensuring seamless integration, operation, and cyber security of OT, ICS, and SCADA systems.

Your responsibilities include:

- Leading risk assessments of IT/OT environments for clients across large-scale renewable assets, and providing risk mitigation strategies and recommendations.
- Developing IT/OT operating models, guidelines, and procedures for renewable assets.
- Developing and communicating IT/OT infrastructure designs to our customers.
- Implementing cyber security solutions for IT and OT environments on large-scale renewable assets, and reporting to project management, customers directly, and/or other senior engineering functions.
- Adapt to legislation and regulatory requirements for the IT/OT environment. Advise on the utilisation of best practices, policies, and standards, such as IEC62443, and ISO27000.
- Build strong relationships with stakeholders, in PEAK Wind and among our customers.

What you Bring and your Qualities
We expect that you have a minimum of 2-4 years of experience from a similar position, and previous experience with cyber security functions, such as Risk Management, Vulnerability Assessments, and Security Assessments. Furthermore, experience within security systems including firewalls and security engineering is required. Recognized security certification is desirable and experience with implementation of national standards such as NERC/CIP or NIS2 would be considered an advantage. The ideal candidate would have experience with renewable energy projects and/or implementation of Cyber Security Management Systems in other industries.

As a person, you are a team player, and you thrive working in an international and diverse team with mixed cultures and seniorities. You are detail-oriented and possess strong problem-solving skills in IT/OT systems. As PEAK Wind is a global company, you must also have strong English communication skills, both oral and written. Finally, we are looking for a candidate with excellent stakeholder management skills.

Experience the Highest Degree of Involvement
PEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity and our values of Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity are materialized through our team members every day. Here you will be able to utilize your financial skills while developing a strong understanding of renewable energy assets. We offer an opportunity to get on board and experience the highest degree of involvement and responsibility in PEAK Wind’s global renewable energy team. Together with the rest of the team, you will play an instrumental part in the continued success of PEAK Wind. Above that, you will participate in an entrepreneurial environment, with a focus on cooperation and a desire to change the status quo. The position will also offer global exposure as our clients work globally.

Interested and want to know more?
If you have any questions or want to know more about the position, please contact People & Development via recruitment@peak-wind.com (recruitment@peak-wind.com) . We look forward to receiving your applications & CVs as soon as possible. Please apply through ‘Apply’ at the bottom of the page. Applications will be assessed on an ongoing basis.

PEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.
